_doc: Per-fixture node-size ratchet for the object DOT-parity suite (decisions.md#d4). Fixtures listed here are structurally EQUAL but their maxSizeDeltaIn (inches) is not yet 0; the test asserts delta <= pinned value + 1e-6, so a delta may only shrink. Phase L size iterations lower entries to 0 and DELETE them (absent slug = 0 required). Values captured 2026-07-11 at ratchet creation; re-measured 2026-07-11 after Phase L iter 7 (raw-display object member rows). RE-BASELINED 2026-08-10: the 2026-07-11 pins were badly stale -- 14 fixtures had reached exactly 0 and are DELETED per this file's own convention, and 7 more were lowered to their measured value. No pin was raised. Remaining entries are grouped by IDENTICAL delta, which is the signature of a shared mechanism rather than N independent bugs. TILDE-ESCAPE FIX 2026-08-10: 6 more fixtures reached 0 and are DELETED -- jocamu-71-nuvo330, nukera-08-dige359, nulixu-97-nofi684, sibika-09-sipu286, sorisi-53-xebi982, vocute-12-suxa445. One cause: the object header measured and emitted classifier.display RAW, so creole's '~' escape never ran. CharHidder.hide maps ~X (X markup-significant) to U+E000+X, consuming the tilde, and AtomText's constructor unhides it; the object path had neither. 'object "~#1: Person"' therefore drew a literal '~' worth 8.225px of node width. That 8.225px is exactly the 0.114236 pin jocamu-71 carried, which is why it closed with the 0.058507 five.
